rationale: Edge-case lens found no blocking defects: the hardcoded 'Claude-Code' literal is replaced with session?.harness_name, the field was added only to SessionDetail (not SessionRow/the list view), and a new SessionModal.test.tsx covers the change. 1 finding dismissed as noise (version-skew scenario the backend's already-merged non-empty fallback already covers). 1 finding deferred (unchecked API-boundary cast typing harness_name as a guaranteed string — a pre-existing pattern already used for every other required field on SessionRow/SessionDetail, not introduced by this change; see code-review-deferred.md). acceptance lens did not run — no story/spec artifact existed for this change (genuine no-spec), which caps confidence at low; blind and verification-gap were out of roster for the compact profile; standards audit was not expected for this profile and is reported na with no coverage gap.
